faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, all our quotes are completely free and without obligation. Schedule a visit and we'll give you a detailed estimate.
faq.q2: How long does a remodeling project take?
faq.a2: It depends on the scope. A typical kitchen remodel takes between 3 and 6 weeks. New construction can take 4 to 8 months.
faq.a3: Yes, we have all required licenses and insurance in the state of Oklahoma for your peace of mind.
faq.q4: Do you work throughout the Guymon area?
faq.a4: Yes, we serve Guymon and surrounding areas within a 50-mile radius.
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5: We accept transfers, checks, and cash. We also offer staged payment plans for large projects.
